WHAT YOU WRITE: new file claude_sdk_client.rs. Module doc: `//! Thin Claude Agent SDK client: drives the Node sidecar through the shared JSONL process, session and client core.` plus the usual explanatory `#![allow(dead_code)]` (a later packet wires it in; say so in a comment).
  pub fn sidecar_launch_args(sdk_module: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String>   // production launch: ["--input-type=module", "-e", SIDECAR_SOURCE.to_string()] followed, when sdk_module is Some(p), by ["--", "--sdk-module", p]
  const SIDECAR_SOURCE: &str = include_str!("../../../sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs");
  pub const EFFORT_LEVELS: [&str; 5] = ["low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"];   // ponytail: fixed list; the SDK reports per-model effort support, refine later
  pub struct ClaudeSdkClient { core: RpcClientCore, state: Box<Mutex<ClaudeState>> }   // Box keeps the SessionClient enum variants size-comparable (clippy::large_enum_variant); ClaudeState { models: Vec<(String, String)> /* (value, display name) */, current_model: String, current_effort: String }
  pub fn spawn(program: &Path, program_args: &[String], cwd: &Path, model: Option<&str>, resume: Option<&str>, init_timeout: Duration) -> Result<ClaudeSdkClient, String>:
     1) JsonlProcess::spawn(program, program_args, cwd) (Err -> "failed to spawn claude sdk sidecar: {e}")
     2) send `init` with {cwd: cwd.to_string_lossy(), model (only if Some), resume (only if Some)}; then poll process.try_recv every 5ms until a Record whose `type` == "response" and `id` == the init id arrives, or the deadline passes: Err containing the stderr tail on timeout / on JsonlRecord::Exited / on JsonlRecord::Error before the response; any OTHER record that arrives first is pushed onto a `pending: Vec<Value>` (not dropped)
     3) success:false -> Err(format!("claude sdk init failed: {error}")); success:true -> build an RpcHandshake: session_id = data.sessionId (required string, else Err), session_file None, model_id = model.map(str::to_string), thinking_level None, models = data.models entries mapped to RpcModel { id: value, name: displayName (fallback to value), provider: "claude".to_string(), reasoning: false } (entries without a string `value` are skipped), thinking_levels = EFFORT_LEVELS as Strings, commands = data.commands entries with a string `name` mapped to RpcCommand { name, description: description as Option<String> }, context_window None, pending
     4) if resume is Some(id) and the handshake session_id != id -> Err(format!("claude sdk resumed a different session: asked {id}, got {got}"))
     5) state: models from the handshake as (id, name) pairs, current_model = model.map(str::to_string) or else "default" (the SDK alias), current_effort = "medium" (ponytail comment: the SDK default is not reported yet); core = RpcClientCore::new(RpcSession::new(process, handshake, map_sdk_message), None)  (no run-finished hook: Claude reports usage in its `result` message, which the mapper already turns into a usage event)
  Methods (all &self, delegating to self.core where the signature matches PiRpcClient's): session_id, begin_prompt, cancel, prompt_in_flight, poll_event, wait_event, shutdown, host_exited; plus
     pub fn config_options(&self) -> Vec<SessionConfigOption>: a "model" select (name "Model", category Model, one option per (value, name), current = state.current_model; omitted when there are no models) and an "effort" select (name "Effort", category ThoughtLevel, one option per EFFORT_LEVELS entry with value and name equal to the level, current = state.current_effort) -- same schema constructors as PiRpcClient::config_options in pi_rpc_client.rs; ids are "model" and "effort" (NOT "thought_level"): they match what the ACP bridge advertised, so persisted pins like `opus|effort=low` keep working
     pub fn applied_model(&self) -> String: state.current_model
     pub fn set_model(&self, value: &str) -> Result<(), String>: self.core.with_session(|s| s.request("set_model", json!({"model": value}), Duration::from_secs(10)))?? then store current_model
     pub fn set_effort(&self, level: &str) -> Result<(), String>: reject levels not in EFFORT_LEVELS with Err(format!("unknown effort level: {level}")); else request("set_effort", json!({"level": level})) then store current_effort
